libraryName: Embedded Coder Support Package for Qualcomm Hexagon

blocks.name: QNN CPU Predict
blocks.maskDescription: Predict responses of a deep learning network represented as a QNN model for the CPU backend of Qualcomm AI Direct Engine. The block accepts QNN model as a compiled shared object (.dll or .so) for execution on x86-based host. For the target, the block accepts another compiled shared object (.so) that is optimized to run on CPU backend. To dequantize outputs to single-precision, select Dequantize output.

blocks.name: QNN HTP Predict
blocks.maskDescription: Predict responses of a deep learning network represented as a QNN model or QNN context binary for the HTP (NPU) backend of Qualcomm AI Direct Engine. The block accepts QNN model as a compiled shared object (.dll or .so) for execution on x86-based host. For the target, the block accepts either a compiled shared object (.so) or a QNN context binary file (.bin) that are optimized to run on HTP (NPU) backend. To dequantize outputs to single-precision, select Dequantize output.
